records.title: Oracle character recognition using universal inverted bottleneck and inverse image frequency
records.reason: QROB targets OCR of ancient oracle-bone characters with a task-specific recognition model, an independent document-vision application rather than LLM inference systems.

records.title: PrivyNAS: Privacy-Aware Neural Architecture Search for Split Computing in Edge–Cloud Systems
records.reason: PrivyNAS optimizes privacy-aware split inference across edge and cloud and balances model accuracy, execution latency, and privacy. Its abstract is about generic DNNs rather than LLM/VLM serving, so transfer to the target systems is plausible but unshown.

records.title: Generalizing RNN-Transducer to Out-Domain Audio via Sparse Self-Attention Layers
records.reason: The sparse attention and state-reset changes target out-domain speech recognition quality for RNN-T/Conformer; the abstract reports character-error reduction, not an LLM inference-system contribution.

records.title: NASA: Neural Architecture Search and Acceleration for Hardware Inspired Hybrid Networks
records.reason: NASA combines multiplication-reduced neural architectures with a dedicated accelerator and auto-mapper to improve DNN hardware efficiency, a concrete accelerator/kernel-level efficiency contribution relevant to model execution.

records.title: cosmosage: A Natural-Language Assistant for Cosmologists
records.reason: cosmosage is a cosmology question-answering assistant and is evaluated for domain answer quality; the abstract describes no serving or inference-efficiency method.

records.title: PRET: Planning with Directed Fidelity Trajectory for Vision and Language Navigation
records.reason: PRET reduces computation for vision-and-language navigation with directed-graph trajectory planning, but its optimization is confined to an independent navigation application rather than language-model serving.

records.title: Repository Structure-Aware Training Makes SLMs Better Issue Resolver
records.reason: ReSAT is training-data construction and training for repository issue-resolution quality in SLMs; it does not establish inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: TurboFuzzLLM: Turbocharging Mutation-based Fuzzing for Effectively Jailbreaking Large Language Models in Practice
records.reason: TurboFuzzLLM improves adversarial jailbreak discovery and attack success for LLM safety testing; its fuzzing efficiency is for security evaluation, not model inference.

records.title: Beyond Cosine Decay: On the effectiveness of Infinite Learning Rate Schedule for Continual Pre-training
records.reason: The work compares learning-rate schedules for continual pre-training and reports training performance; it is training-only rather than inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Mitigating Hallucinations via Inter-Layer Consistency Aggregation in Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: DCLA is a training-free decoding method for reducing LVLM hallucinations and improving benchmark accuracy; the abstract does not establish lower inference cost or serving performance.

records.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of LLM-Based Reasoning for Multiobjective HPC Job Scheduling
records.reason: The work evaluates LLM reasoning as a multiobjective scheduler for HPC workloads and explicitly notes computational overhead that challenges real-time use. This concerns using an LLM to schedule HPC jobs, not scheduling LLM inference workloads, so the systems connection remains indirect.

records.title: MaskCD: Mitigating LVLM Hallucinations by Image Head Masked Contrastive Decoding
records.reason: MaskCD targets hallucination and output quality in vision-language models through contrastive decoding; the abstract does not report inference-efficiency gains.
